notes.title: Toribash 5.44 - August Update
notes.notes:
Hi!
This update is mainly focused on remastering the Bounty system, realtime ghosts and bug fixes to the Toribash 5.44

Bounty updates
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6036085/42e6403bc371fb7b677b6fa5f1833c6ee39c8f9b.png
You can now view the list of active bounties, add bounties on your friends and see your global bounty stats!

In addition to game client updates, we've done several updates to the game servers that were pushed live earlier previous Friday:
 Getting a win streak of 5 (on at least 3 different players) will automatically trigger a 500 TC bounty on your head
 Every fight you win in a public room with an active bounty will make you win a portion of it - you essentially get a TC booster!
 Joining a room with a bounty on will notify everyone inside that you're being hunted

We've also removed the old 2000 TC fee on adding bounties, woohoo!


Realtime ghost updates

In short, we've made it possible to see realtime ghosts not only for spectators, but also for players currently fighting. We're also going to enable realtime ghosts in most public rooms later this week for everyone to try it out, so get ready to mind games with your opponents!

To try realtime ghosts in your own rooms, use /realtimeghost command.



Read the full list of updates in this version on Toribash forums

Login rewards screen is now always shown even if game client failed to connect to rewards server on launch (won't show proper day streak and time left to claim but you should still be able to claim your reward if it's available)
Changed movememory data file to data/script/system/movememory.mm to prevent it from resetting when verifying cache integrity

notes.title: Login Rewards boost and Steam Cloud update
notes.notes:
Hi!
Earlier this week, [strike]hampa tripped over some cables[/strike] our game server went down, making all Toribash multiplayer rooms unavailable. To compensate for that, we're bumping login rewards for this weekend - you will be able to claim 50 TC Booster or Shiai Token every day. Enjoy!


We've also updated some Steam Cloud settings:
All your replays from "my replays" folder will now sync across your devices
Movememory data should no longer get deleted when verifying cache integrity (and will also be available on your Steam-connected devices)

notes.title: Toribash January update
notes.notes:
Hi!
New in this month's update:
Betting system enhancements (suggestion on forums):
Automatic bet payback when no counter bets has been placed
Automatic bet refunds in case of players being afk
More informative status messages
Fight winnings scaling based on your current streak (suggestion on forums) - multiplier starts at streak 3 and increases with every new opponent you defeat

More information in post-fight message (shown in the middle of the screen) - now shows both Qi and TC you've earned

Fixes:
Ignore feature now should work when ignored user isn't part of any clan
ST balance display should no longer randomly reset to 0 while in multiplayer
Games to next belt shows actual Qi left and not how much was left before current fight
Other miscellaneous fixes

notes.title: May Torishop Update and Lottery
notes.notes:
Hi!

May Torishop update has just been pushed live and it has plenty of changes that (are supposed to) make shop navigation easier. Here's the new stuff:


Separation between single items and item packs

https://puu.sh/vTS36/6aad5fb8bc.png

We have separated regular single items (colors, single textures, hairstyles, 3d models and misc stuff) from item packs that allow you to instantly customize your character. You don't have to wonder where to find Mecha Arms anymore, wow!

Intuitive sections

https://puu.sh/vTSiB/bc168f6ab2.png

There's a total of 8 item sections which are split equally between Single Items and Item Packs, and they (kinda?) make sense! You won't find Hair Color items in Models section anymore, nor will you struggle finding preloaded Full Texture Sets.

ToriLottery is back

Hampa says lotteries are for the elderly. 
We like them nonetheless. This May, get a chance to win Cobra Pack by spending just 100 TC (or Demon Pack if you like playing big)!
Access the Beginner and Pro lotteries from Torishop or get tickets on forum: http://forum.toribash.com/tori_lottery.php

notes.title: Torishop update and new items available!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Toribashians!

We have just submitted an update that brings new functionality to Torishop.
From now on you will not only be able to see what items you can buy up to the next belt you'll have but also all items available for USD. Note that USD items can be purchased from Torishop at any belt, no matter what the QI restriction for them is.

The update also includes 4 new items recently released by Gamemasters: Blindfold, Punkspikes for both hands and Bunny Ears. All items are available for $5 each.

http://puu.sh/h2quC.png

New features:
Main screen with the latest shop updates
Easier section navigation
Torishop shows if you have enough qi and TC to buy items
General design changes

Purchase button for USD-only items is hidden for now, will be displayed with the new game client release.

To get the Torishop update in Steam, switch to the "-beta" branch in the "betas" tab in properties.
